rows.text: wins a **three-year tendered contract, as one of two successful bidders, to print and handle policy bond kits and related logistics for an unnamed public-sector life insurer** it already serves; value not disclosed, revenue tied to volumes.
buys a 1,600 sq m factory premises at Peenya IV Phase, Bangalore from M/s Balaji Industries for **Rs 17.21 crore**, to expand manufacturing capacity.
